actual_Boolean_family: Eight explicit seeds (constants +/- on one bit, dictator, AND2, parity2, majority3, quadratic bent4, point-defect4), tensor/parity/point activation; additionally point seeds at n=2,3,4 for bounded-degree coarse-graining
symmetry: None in the finite truth-table checks; symbolic cases use proved exact factorized spectra, without constructing exponential ambient truth tables
arithmetic: Integer Walsh transforms, direct physical flips, Fraction probabilities, exact dictionaries of prime logarithms; rational analytic comparisons for symbolic cases
